svg.title: Four separate access layers
svg.desc: An Entra tenant contains an Azure subscription, resource group, Foundry account, and native project. Tenant consent permits organization sign-in. Fifteen Azure management Actions authorize subscription-wide FoundryX Access management. Native project data access is separately needed to read Toolboxes. A dashed box represents the FoundryX application ACL for that project, with Consumer, User, Manager, and Owner roles. It is not an Azure resource or an inherited Azure role.
svg.text: One project. Four separate access layers.
Resource scope does not make tenant consent, Azure roles, and FoundryX ACLs interchangeable.
01 / ORGANIZATION
Microsoft Entra tenant
Admin consent + tenant activation let users sign in. They do not grant project access.
02 / AZURE MANAGEMENT ACTIONS
Azure subscription
Administrator needs all 15 Access management Actions at this scope.
Owner, Contributor + User Access Administrator, or qualifying custom roles can supply them.
Resource group / Foundry account
Model deployments are read from the parent account through Azure management APIs.
03 / NATIVE FOUNDRY DATA ACCESS
Native Foundry project
To discover Toolboxes, the administrator also needs native project data access.
Azure Foundry User is one sufficient data role. Subscription Owner alone is not.
04 / FOUNDRYX PROJECT ACL - APPLICATION ACCESS, NOT AZURE RBAC
Assigned during Grant access; controls recipients' access through FoundryX.
Consumer
User
Manager
Owner
Solid boxes: Azure scopes. Dashed box: the registered project's separate FoundryX access list.
The permission-based subscription check must be deployed in your environment; see the guide's rollout note.
